scenario.title: Crete - Invasion
intro.text:
CRETE - INVASION - 20 MAY 1941

Chania, Crete

The crazy Germans actually try to conquer Crete from the air! Thwart this venture and destroy the German airborne troops!

Hold after the twelfth turn 6 VH, 5 VH or 4 VH for BV, V or TV!

NOTE In this mission the AI has the first turn! Last chance to buy a tank for the next six scenarios! ;)
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-9-0-briliant.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.reaction-9-0-briliant.text: The line held through every scheduled hour. German columns reached the southern roads after the evacuation timetable had already moved beyond them.
line.reaction-9-1-victory-tactical.text: The required part of the line survived, though several positions closed earlier than planned. The withdrawal continues because enough roads remained contested.
line.reaction-9-2-lose.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.reaction-9-2-lose.text: Thermopylae broke before everyone could get away. The units we've got left are coming to Crete. I'll count them when they land; don't promise the island a full formation yet.
line.callback-0.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.callback-0.text: The broad line kept forcing the Germans to deploy. The fleet got the time it needed. I also have the village casualty returns, if you can spare a moment before we discuss Crete.
line.callback-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-1.text: Brallos, Amfiklia, Levadia—and tractors still attached to the guns. Some officers called your line thin. Those officers reached the ships with it.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.earned-decision.text: The Thermopylae anti-aircraft section has reached Crete with three guns and ammunition for rather more. The gunners want their unit back. Every battalion wants the belts.
line.earned-decision.choice.keep-the-aam: Keep the anti-aircraft machine-gun section intact.
Add an experienced seven-strength AAMG detachment.
line.earned-decision.choice.distribute-t: Distribute the gunners and ammunition through the core.
Restore the core to at least nine strength and fully rearm it.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.earned-a-response.text: Return the three guns to them. They already know how to fire while the road behind them is disappearing.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.earned-b-response.text: Distribute the ammunition belts and put the gunners with the battalions as instructors. The men need to recognise an approaching transport before the landings begin.
line.scene-0.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.scene-0.text: The villagers are carrying ammunition up and wounded men down the same path. We've turned the schoolyard into a dressing station. If you send more men toward the landings, keep that path clear for us.
line.scene-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.scene-1.text: Hill 107 sees Maleme. If the Germans hold it, tomorrow's troops arrive in aircraft instead of under silk.
line.scene-2.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.scene-2.text: And if every reserve goes to the hill, the docks and the road through Aghya belong to whoever lands second.
line.decision.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.decision.text: Do we commit now to Hill 107, or keep the reserve moving between Aghya and the docks until the landings show their weight?
line.decision.choice.hold-hill-107.text: Commit the reserve to Hill 107 and the airfield approaches.
line.decision.choice.hold-hill-107.hint: Give anti-aircraft and anti-tank formations 15 experience and fully rearm the core.
line.decision.choice.guard-the-docks.tex: Keep a mobile reserve between Aghya and the docks.
line.decision.choice.guard-the-docks.hin: Restore the core to at least nine strength, fully refuel and rearm it, and give reconnaissance 10 experience.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.choice-a-0.text: Then give the villages rifles and a signal plan. You are taking away the one formed unit that could answer them.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.choice-a-1.text: The reserve goes to Hill 107 at once. If the Germans hold the height and Maleme, they'll fly reinforcements onto the runway. We have to stop that now.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.choice-b-0.text: By the time the picture is clear, Maleme may already have a runway full of transports.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Eleni Markou
line.choice-b-1.text: The reserve carries stretchers with its ammunition and moves when a landing begins to organise. I can find guides for the roads; I cannot replace the battalion if the hill swallows it.
